check_names: Default original presentation keeps exact coordinate values and source order
Unintegrated source basis is used explicitly without falling back to Harmony
Missing coordinate pairs remain unavailable rather than becoming invented positions
Compact layout compresses centroid distances by the selected factor
Compact translation retains each within-cluster displacement vector and cluster shape
Compact spacing one restores exact source doubles with an explicit presentation mode flag
Manual cluster shifts use the complete source span and affect only the selected cluster
Manual scaling is uniform around the selected cluster centroid
Global rotation and reflection preserve all pairwise distances
A complete turn is treated as exact original orientation
Hippocampus-like mode is finite, deterministic and explicitly non-anatomical
Schematic ordering is independent of input row order and retains each nucleus identity
Schematic modes apply only uniform scaling to each cluster local geometry
Resetting to original reverses every presentation change without a source edit
Inherited customization is ignored and nonfinite settings are safely normalized
Invalid option containers safely restore the original display
Expansion is supported and manual movement never claims original intercluster distances
Empty, all-missing, one-cluster and coincident-coordinate populations remain valid
Source counts, identity fields and complete input arrays are never mutated
Inhibitory native Seurat array retains every stable ID, coordinate and cluster membership
CA1_ProS native Seurat array retains every stable ID, coordinate and cluster membership
